source_proposal.lane_entry: A8 replacement (post-F1 remediation): the previously selected V17-A4-P2-SILRES died by its own frozen falsification rule 4 (measured anchor trigger duty 0.81%/0.99% outside the frozen [5%,60%] window - kill accepted, never argued); the next-ranked lane-1 survivor V17-A4-P1-WKNDLIQ enters selection via the frozen rubric's mandatory-lane rule

frozen_semantics.exposure: pure calendar flag on the published UTC-H1 grid: weekend_flag(t) = 1 if (day_utc(t)=Friday AND hour_utc(t)>=22) OR day_utc(t) in {Saturday, Sunday}, else 0; the decision bucket is the Friday hour_utc=21 close (anchor) / Friday 19:00 close (neighbour); series = -1.0 at the decision bucket, 0.0 elsewhere; no price/flow/size column is consumed and no warmup lookback exists (0 warmup decisions), so the one-bar availability law is satisfied trivially
frozen_semantics.entry_fill: SHORT 1 unit notional per symbol independently; entry.lag_buckets 0 + fill_price vwap => the fill executes at the position bucket's published VWAP, which by the one-bar lag IS the next bucket after the decision: the Friday 22:00 bucket vwap (anchor) / Friday 20:00 bucket vwap (neighbour)
frozen_semantics.cover: Monday 00:00 bucket vwap (anchor) / Monday 02:00 bucket vwap (neighbour) => exit.holding_buckets 50 (family) / 54 (neighbour arm override) on the UTC-H1 grid: Friday 22:00 -> Monday 00:00 is exactly 50 held buckets and Friday 20:00 -> Monday 02:00 is exactly 54. RECONCILIATION (recorded, QUESTION_FOR_A1): the frozen text labels these spans '26 buckets' / '30 buckets' - a systematic one-day (24h) under-count of the weekend span; the frozen calendar anchors (day_utc + hour_utc, stated three times each across entry_exit_fills/anchor/neighbour) are implemented verbatim and the spans are derived from them
frozen_semantics.no_reentry: one decision per week (the series is nonzero at exactly one bucket per week), short-only, no pyramiding, no re-entry inside the week; BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT traded independently with symmetric 1 unit
frozen_semantics.force_flat: driver purge law (SILRES convention): any decision whose holding window touches a +/-1-full-UTC-day purged fold boundary, a fold edge, or the grid end is never booked; the book resumes at the next qualifying calendar boundary after the purge
frozen_semantics.control: randomized session-boundary sham, frozen mechanics verbatim: numpy default_rng seed 17040001, ONE draw per week over S0 (weeks = the 168-bucket Friday-anchored windows hosting each anchor decision, ascending), uniform over exactly the weekly entry offsets whose equally-long (50-bucket, duration-matched) window does NOT overlap the true anchor window - Friday-anchored offsets 72..140 (Monday 00:00 .. Wednesday 20:00 starts; 69 offsets); entry at the drawn offset's bucket vwap, cover 50 buckets later at the bucket vwap; identical fill timing, once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs and force-flat law. RECONCILIATION (recorded, QUESTION_FOR_A1): the frozen text says '144 hourly offsets' - the same one-day under-count (excluding exactly 24 offsets cannot realise 'do not overlap the true anchor window' against the true 50-bucket window); the seed, one-draw-per-week, no-overlap and equal-duration mechanics are implemented verbatim. G11 contract: sham reproduces the anchor (same sign AND |sham pooled after-cost expectancy| >= 0.5 x |anchor pooled after-cost expectancy|) => family DIES
frozen_semantics.frozen_rule_enforcement: falsification_rule (4) VERBATIM and FAIL-CLOSED in the driver path (closes A7 finding F1's unenforced-rule gap for THIS family): fewer than 12 scored weekend events in ANY single fold kills the family (calendar coverage insufficient to test the session boundary). run_v17_cell evaluates it on the anchor T2.0 book of every scored cell of this family and the cell record ALWAYS carries frozen_rule_enforcement {rule_id, per_fold_scored_events, min_fold_scored_events, verdict PASS|DEAD_FROZEN_RULE_COVERAGE, family_alive}; a below-floor fold marks the family DEAD in the cell output (the pre-registered REJECT path, never silently skippable - an unevaluable anchor book refuses the cell). Scored weekend event = one booked anchor round trip (one per symbol-weekend)
frozen_semantics.costs: taker fee EXACTLY ONCE PER FILL (L-V14-0), TIER 2.0 PRIMARY BOOK (fee 5.0 bps x 2.0 = 10.0 bps per fill, slip floor 2 ticks) - frozen driver kernel; two taker fills per symbol per weekend round trip
